title.zh: Jupiter推出对标PaperTrade的高杠杆交易产品YOLO，最高支持1000倍杠杆
title.en: Jupiter推出对标PaperTrade的高杠杆交易产品YOLO，最高支持1000倍杠杆

current_state.zh: Jupiter Labs launched YOLO, an experimental high-leverage trading product offering 500-1000x leverage that simulates positions at real market prices with real PnL, funded by a pool whose payouts can be queued if liquidity is insufficient.
